info.title: Insurance Claim Resolution Control Tower
info.description: Prototype. SYNTHETIC data only. Agents marked `YET TO IMPLEMENT (mock)` return labelled fixtures. A human decides every approval, denial and payment; the system only recommends.

post.description:
Create a claim from its documents in ONE request and assess it once, to the human gate. Every field is optional: what is missing (name, policy, loss date, description) is read from the
claim form by the intake agent, and what you supply is kept. A file that is empty, too large or unreadable is skipped and listed in `skipped`; the claim is created if at least one file was stored.
Later evidence goes to `POST /claims/{id}/documents` (which re-assesses the claim).

schema.title: Response Get Versions Claims  Claim Id  Versions Get
Response List Documents Claims  Claim Id  Documents Get

post.description:
Store the document and, unless `reassess=false`, re-assess the claim from the intake node (the checklist and header are refreshed, the notice of loss is read if it is new; the policy node is skipped when nothing it reads changed): only the new document is processed, and a pending
recommendation at the human gate is superseded (nobody had decided yet).

get.description: The page as a picture. With `fact`, the place that fact was read from is marked (header `X-Highlight`: region | text | none).

schema.title: Response List Policy Documents Policies Documents Get

post.description:
Add a policy wording or endorsement. The file may be called anything: the document id and version are read from INSIDE the document (a line such as
'Policy wording BASE-HOME-1 | Version 2025-01'); `document_id` is only for a document that has none. The same content again is `unchanged`; different content under an
existing id is 409 unless `replace=true`. Claims already assessed are not changed: re-assess one with POST /claims/{id}/reassess.

Run the claim again from `from_node` (default: the policy node, to pick up a policy document added since). Nodes before it are not run; nodes after it whose inputs
did not change are skipped. A recommendation waiting at the gate is superseded.

approve | reject | request_more_evidence, by a named reviewer whose role reaches the claim's required approver role. The system only recommends:
an approval pays and denies nothing. A refused decision (role too low, reason missing ...) leaves the gate open and returns 422 with the reason.

note.title: Note
note.default: In-memory event log of the prototype: it does not survive a restart. A persistent audit trail (T8.3) will keep it.

BBox.title: BBox
BBox.description: Region on a page/image, normalised 0..1 in page coordinates.

files.title: Files
files.description: The claim's documents: claim form, reports, estimate, invoice, photos, schedule ...

use_synthetic_documents.title: Use Synthetic Documents
use_synthetic_documents.description: Load the SYNTHETIC documents of data/synthetic/claims/<claim_id> into the claim (demo).

ClaimCreate.title: ClaimCreate
ClaimCreate.description:
Create a claim and run it to the human gate. Everything is optional: with no id one is generated, with no header the intake agent reads the
claim's first notice of loss (a stored document) and fills what is missing; what you supply is kept.

ClaimView.title: ClaimView
ClaimView.description: A claim: where it stands (phase, gate, which agents are mocks) and its full state at the current version.

stored.title: Stored
stored.description: The documents stored with the claim (their types are decided when the claim is assessed).

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Files that were not stored (empty, too large, unreadable) and why. They do not fail the claim.

ClaimWithDocumentsResult.title: ClaimWithDocumentsResult
ClaimWithDocumentsResult.description: The claim created from its documents in one call: the claim run once to the human gate, the documents stored, and any file that was skipped and why.

DocumentDetails.title: DocumentDetails
DocumentDetails.description: What the system read in one document (T7.3): how it was typed and why, the pages and where their text came from, and the fields extracted with page, region and confidence.

reassessment.description: The claim re-assessed from the intake node (null when the claim was not re-run).

DuplicateCandidate.title: DuplicateCandidate
DuplicateCandidate.description: A *possible* duplicate. Never fraud, never auto-merged (guardrail 3).

Fact.title: Fact
Fact.description: Provenance is mandatory. evidence_text must be a verbatim substring of the page (checked in T2.4).

HumanDecision.title: HumanDecision
HumanDecision.description: What a reviewer sends to the gate. Reject and request_more_evidence need a reason.

PolicyDocumentView.title: PolicyDocumentView
PolicyDocumentView.description: One policy document in the library. The id and version were read from INSIDE the document (`id_from`), not taken from the file name.

RunStatus.title: RunStatus
RunStatus.description: Where a claim stands, in the words the API and the UI need.

TrailView.title: TrailView
TrailView.description: The persistent audit trail of one claim (T8.3): append-only, hash-chained, enough to reconstruct the decision.

VersionInfo.title: VersionInfo
VersionInfo.description: One committed version of a claim's state and what produced it.
